title: Zoho Cliq review: 3.4 GPA, pricing and who it is for
snippet:
Free plan · from $16.20/mo[Team Chat](/categories/team-chat)[Checked](https://www.zoho.com/cliq/pricing.html) Oct 9, 2026 · graded Oct 10, 2026 by ToolGPA4.8 on the App Store

- AValue for moneyStandard is $16.20 a month for up to 25 people, the whole team, which is about 65 cents a head. Professional is $1.80 a user and Enterprise $3.60, against the $7 a month this category typically starts at. Nothing else here is close on price.
- CFree plan and trialFree covers the whole team with 100 GB of storage between you, but it has a memory problem: only 10,000 messages are searchable, which ten people get through in a month. Meetings end at 60 minutes, and there's no call recording or outside channels until you pay.

Standard is $16.20 a month for up to 25 people. That's the whole team, not each person. With 25 of you it works out at about 65 cents a head.

Start free. It covers the whole team, with 100 GB of storage between you and meetings for up to 100 people.
Standard is $16.20 a month on yearly billing, or $18 month to month, for up to 25 users. You get unlimited search, call recording, 24-hour meetings and channels you can share with people outside the company.
Professional is $1.80 a person a month on yearly billing, or $2 monthly, with a 10-user minimum. That adds guest chat, tasks, roles and permissions, live events and chat summaries, and storage goes up to 100 GB each.
Enterprise is $3.60 a person, or $4 monthly, again for at least 10. It adds audit history, eDiscovery and data loss prevention. We'd skip it unless someone in legal or IT is asking for those.
Paying yearly saves 10%. There's a free trial of the paid plans as well. The home page says 15 days and the pricing FAQ says 14, so call it two weeks.

Its paid plans start at $16.20 a month, against a middle price of $7 for the category: 22 of the 28 others that charge start lower.

- The Free plan searches only 10,000 messages, caps meetings at 60 minutes and has no call recording or external channels.
- Standard is a flat price covering up to 25 users, while Professional and Enterprise are per user with a 10-user minimum.
- Guest chat, task management, roles and permissions, and live events need Professional or Enterprise.
- Audit history, eDiscovery and data loss prevention are limited to Enterprise.

Developer platformBots, slash commands, message actions, functions, schedulers, databases and widgets are available on every plan with per-plan quotas, alongside a REST API.

title: Zoho Cliq Pricing 2026
snippet:
Zoho Cliq offers **4 pricing editions**, starting from **$0** to **$18**. Zoho Cliq pricing tiers are designed to support different usage levels and team sizes.

---
Free — $0
Professional — $2 / 1 user Per Month
Enterprise — $4 / 1 User Per Month
Standard — $18 / 25 Users Per Month
Rated 4.4 / 5

### Is Zoho Cliq free, or does it offer a free trial?
Yes. According to G2 data, Zoho Cliq offers a free plan with limited features. Users can upgrade to paid plans for additional capabilities. Visit the seller's official pricing page to compare plan options and features.

Zoho Cliq's free tier covers core messaging, channels, file storage, meetings with screen sharing, and chat export, making it functional for basic internal communication. However, G2 reviewers note limitations on the free plan, including capped group sizes and reduced support responsiveness. Zoho Cliq's paid tiers unlock significantly more capability: the Standard plan at $18.00/month adds external channels, call recording, and custom domains; the Professional plan at $2.00/month introduces task management, roles and permissions, and live events; and the Enterprise plan at $4.00/month adds audit history, eDiscovery, and advanced usage reports.
